title: Thank you Lord
lyrics_original: And there’s just one thing that I want to say
Thank You, Lord, thank You Lord
For all You’ve given to me
For all the blessings that I cannot see
Thank You, Lord, thank You, Lord
With a grateful heart, with a song of praise
With an outstretched arm, I will bless Your Name
Thank you, Lord, I just want to thank You, Lord
Thank You, Lord, I just want to thank You, Lord
For all You’ve done in my life
You took my darkness and gave me Your blight
Thank You, Lord, thank You, Lord
You took my sin and my shame
You took my sickness and healed all my pain
Thank You, Lord, thank You, Lord     ||With a grateful heart||

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రతి విషయమునందును కృతజ్ఞతాస్తుతులు చెల్లించుడి. ఈలాగు చేయుట యేసుక్రీస్తునందు మీ విషయములో దేవుని చిత్తము.
bible_verses.english: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము ఆయన చేసిన ఉపకారములలో దేనిని మరువకుము
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

bible_verses.telugu: కృతజ్ఞతార్పణలు చెల్లించుచు ఆయన గుమ్మములలో ప్రవేశించుడి కీర్తనలు పాడుచు ఆయన ఆవరణములలో ప్రవేశించుడి ఆయనను స్తుతించుడి ఆయన నామమును ఘనపరచుడి.
bible_verses.english: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, I come before You today with a heart full of praise. Thank You for every blessing You have poured into my life, both the ones I see and the countless graces I fail to notice. Teach me to walk through each moment with a spirit of thanksgiving, always remembering Your unwavering faithfulness. I lift my hands and offer my song to You, simply wanting to say thank You, Lord. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Coming into God's presence often begins with a long list of requests, yet true worship starts by simply pausing to say, 'Thank You.' This song invites us to lift our hands and hearts in sincere gratitude, recognizing not only the obvious gifts in our lives but also the unseen ways God protects and provides for us daily. When we turn our attention toward His goodness, our hearts find rest and joy. Let this simple prayer of thanks recenter your spirit today on the faithful love of Jesus.
